title: Membership in a tree-circuit language
statement: For every Boolean tree-circuit family and every finite Boolean word $w$, the word $w$ belongs to the language recognized by the family if and only if the circuit assigned to input length $|w|$ evaluates to true on the assignment given by the entries of $w$.
